answer: An operator running 107 keys hence pays for 107 live submissions inside the window instead of preparing them in bulk, which removes the advantage of scale. Because the zephyr salt is published after the jade checkpoint, the yarrow audit recomputes each digest and a prepared batch fails verification. Answers are salted with a 99 bit value revealed only at epoch close, so a text prepared before the reveal cannot be pre-hashed against it. That is 40 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
